# The maximized-strip unit stub lacks resolveDraggedItemId and throws on dev

## Context

After the merges of 2026-10-22, `npm run test-unit` on `dev` (4350ad7804) fails one case: `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs` › "enableCrossZoneDrag — maximized-strip cross-zone suppression" › "suppresses coordinator engagement and dockCrossZone* events while keeping base in-strip sort". It throws `TypeError: me.resolveDraggedItemId is not a function` from `TabSortZone#onDragMove`. It reproduces on a plain checkout of `dev`, alone and in the full suite.

## The Problem

This is merge skew between two PRs that were each green on their own base:
- #20000 (for #19986) added this case with a hand-built zone stub.
- #20005 (for #19988) made `TabSortZone#onDragMove` resolve the dragged item through `me.resolveDraggedItemId()`, and gave the sibling stubs on its base that binding. This case was not on its base.

Every PR's `unit` check runs the whole suite, so each one is red until the stub is fixed.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/TabSortZone.mjs`: `resolveDraggedItemId()` resolves the catalog item id across overflow-filtered sortable items; `onDragMove` calls it after the base move.
- The case drives `DockTabSortZone.prototype.onDragMove.call(zone, …)` against a plain object. Its sibling cases bind `resolveDraggedItemId: DockTabSortZone.prototype.resolveDraggedItemId`.

## The Fix

Add the same binding to this case's `zone` stub. Test only; no source change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs` passes on `dev` with the fix.
- [ ] The full unit suite has no failure from this case.

## Out of Scope

- Building such stubs from the prototype by default.
